title: Understanding laboratory tests
keywords: blood test report laboratory lab result normal reference range CBC hemoglobin glucose cholesterol
body: A laboratory result should be interpreted with its units, laboratory-specific reference range, medical history and other findings. A result outside a reference range does not by itself establish a diagnosis.

title: Complete blood count
keywords: CBC blood count hemoglobin platelet white red WBC RBC
body: A complete blood count measures several components of blood, including red cells, white cells and platelets. Ask a healthcare professional to explain your individual results.

title: Blood pressure
body: Blood pressure measurements describe the pressure in arteries. A clinician interprets measurements in context; do not change treatment based on this application.

title: Taking medicines safely
keywords: medicine medication prescription dose refill reminder
body: Follow the instructions provided by your prescriber and pharmacist. Ask them about missed doses, side effects and interactions rather than changing the schedule yourself.

title: Preparing for a medical visit
keywords: doctor appointment consultation visit questions follow up
body: Bring a list of medications, relevant records and questions to your appointment. Discuss your concerns and clarify the next steps with your clinician.
